emails.subject: Welcome aboard, Kunal Das (test)
emails.body:
Settle in.

The task-api incident sits on the table. Sam's first briefing on the left explains the rollback and where your runtime sits now — start there.

Your start time just got logged for event TEST-001 (issue #37). Credit allocation goes to the facilitator's queue; once credits post, the agent is live on your fork.

Read the briefings in order, then fork and ship a PR. We'll keep score.
